_comment: The Intensive English PHONICS standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Phonics is level -1 and lives in level-phonics/, below Intro: adults who cannot yet read the Latin alphabet, built from Cambridge Primary English Phonics Workbooks A and B with their music, art and children's content removed. Its units are numbered from ONE, so every entry carries its own unit number and progress is written under the course's own ids u01..u20. It sits below Cambridge 0057 Stage 1 and cites the 0058 literacy framework. Its narration says SOUNDS, not letter names: tools/lib/ehel-phonics-speech.js.
subject: intensive-english
_stickers: No sticker shelf. The learners are adults: the last slide is the unit's own can-do list, rated by the learner, and the assignment. check-lessons.py reads this flag and stops asking for a STICKERS array.
